text:
jordan-bizdev: Quick shoutout — Quantix.ai is live in AWS Marketplace with our ISV listing 🎉. They also kicked off a 30-day Dedicated pilot this morning. Huge cross-team effort.
elaine-partnerships: Amazing 🙌. Quantix wanted predictable latency for vector search & we shipped the dedicated sizing + SSO in two weeks.
mike-eng: Integration notes: we added a custom batching profile and a small KV cache tweak. Deployed a quantized model variant (q4) for their p99 budget.
sophia-solutions: Nice work. I shipped the onboarding playbook and a starter prompt set for their docs search. Putting a case study template together.
raj-sales: This is a big one for our co-sell motion — Quantix committed to a 12-month seat contract if pilot meets SLOs. I'll sync with their AM for renewals cadence.
marketing-bot: Heads up — draft customer quote request sent to @jordan-bizdev and @elaine-partnerships. Would like a 1–2 paragraph quote and a logo by EOD Thu.
mike-eng: FYI, infra note: we tagged the Dedicated pool as quantix-prod-1 and enabled autoscale:bust. Logs show steady throughput ~120 rps.
deploy-bot: deploy 1765400620: service/quantix-integration v1.3.2 -> success :rocket: (rolling, 3 nodes)
jordan-bizdev: Thanks team — can we schedule a quick 15-min post-mortem on Friday to capture learnings and confirm the case study timeline?
elaine-partnerships: Yes, Friday 10am PT works for me. I'll invite product + AM + marketing.
sophia-solutions: Added a short eval to catch regressions on their prompt set. Will report initial quality metrics Monday.
raj-sales: I'll prep the co-sell materials and a one-pager for the partner portal.
marketing-bot: Draft case study outline: problem, integration, performance numbers, customer quote, next steps. Will share draft in #partnerships-docs.
jordan-bizdev: Perfect. Celebratory donut run courtesy of Quantix on Friday for the SF office? :doughnut:
mike-eng: I'll take one of those :grin:
elaine-partnerships: Love it. Great job everyone — big win for Redwood's marketplace + Dedicated playbook.
